_README: The playtest level: a hub, four stages in order, then back to the hub.
This file is WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json. export_data.py never
overwrites it, and it does not touch the canon workbook at all. That is
deliberate: this level is a shape being tried out, and nothing here
should disturb Module 01 or the stages in the workbook while it settles.
Once the shape is right it can move into the workbook properly.
EVERY NAME AND NUMBER BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER awaiting Cameron.
Opponents are deliberately called 'Opponent A' and so on: the canon rule
is that characters come only from the data files, never invented here.
Casting these from the real roster (OP01-OP09) is Cameron's call.

_rewards_note: WHAT WINNING THIS STAGE IS WORTH. Cameron's numbers to set - these
are deliberately zero, not guesses. The code that applies them is
wired and tested, so the moment a number here stops being 0 it
lands on the player's standing and shows in the briefing screen.
Same key names as the canon stages in stages.json, so nothing new
has to be added to the workbook.
jiban         constituency support
kanban        reputation
kaban         funds
party_support standing with your own party
xp_reward     experience towards unlocking and upgrading cards

stages._turn_limit_note: Twenty turns AGAINST EACH opponent, not twenty for the stage: the clock resets with everything else when one is beaten.

_shape: Six cards to start and no more: you only draw if a card says so.
A series of questions, one card spent answering each.
It is never won or lost on the tone. The tone is the RESULT: it
becomes a buff or a debuff at the floor debate and moves reputation.
Answers also please booster groups, which carries into the floor.
_tone_effects_note: What the closing press tone is worth. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS.
support_per_points: every 10 points of tone above or below the
baseline is one seat at the floor debate, up OR down - allow_negative
is what makes a bad conference an actual debuff rather than nothing.
meta: every 5 points above or below the baseline is one point of
Reputation. Reputation is already the press variable in sanban.json
(below 20 a press stage starts at -5, above 80 at +5), so the tone
feeding it keeps one loop rather than opening a second one.
_decline_note: What ducking a question costs, in press tone. PLACEHOLDER.
Energy is nearly worthless here - six cards for five questions - so
without this a player could decline every awkward question and walk
out with the tone untouched and a clean record. Playtesting found
exactly that. The organisation behind a declined question is also
left unpleased, which is felt later because standing carries between
_questions_note: The wording is Cameron's. The suit each question INVITES, and the
organisation it pleases, are my pairing and are placeholders - one

_name_note: {party} is replaced at render time with the player's party from
player.json, so the caucus is named after whoever the protagonist
turns out to belong to rather than being fixed here. Any stage can
use the token; no other stage needs it yet.
_shape: One opponent, the caucus panel. Three turns.
FIVE ENERGY FOR THE WHOLE STAGE, not five each turn: spend it when
you like, and when it is gone the remaining turns are empty.
No threshold. However high you get the support is your score, and
the score becomes a buff going into the floor debate.
_tone_effects_note: What the closing caucus support is worth, in the same shape the
press conference uses. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS, and these ones are
exactly what the caucus already did: every 10 points above 50 is one
seat at the floor debate, and a poor caucus costs nothing rather
than costing seats. Set allow_negative to true to change that.
_bar_as_percent_note: Read the bar as a percentage of the caucus rather than a headcount.

_shape: Five debaters one after another. Each is their own division of the
house: reach the threshold and THAT DEBATER is finished, then the
next rises and the house divides again from the opening numbers.
One clock and one record across all five, though - your gaffes, your
hand and your deck follow you in, so beating five debaters means
winning five divisions on one set of nerves and one afternoon.
Carries whatever the press conference and the caucus produced.
stages._win_threshold_note: PER DEBATER, not for the stage: 55 members voting to end this particular speaker. Beating the fifth carries the bill.
